question: Who is the author of the book "Miss Laila, Armed and Dangerous"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manu Joseph**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Miss Laila, Armed and Dangerous"** is a novel authored by **Manu Joseph**, an acclaimed Indian writer and journalist.
 
• The book was published in **2017** and is known for its satirical take on contemporary Indian society and politics.
 
• Manu Joseph is a recipient of prestigious awards like the **Hindu Literary Prize** and has been longlisted for the **Man Asian Literary Prize**.
 
• The novel revolves around two women caught in a series of events that explore the themes of surveillance, politics, and societal hypocrisy.
 
• Joseph is widely regarded for his sharp wit and incisive commentary, and this book reflects his unique style of storytelling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manu Joseph:**
 
 
• Born in **1974**, he is an Indian author and former editor of **Open Magazine**.
 
• His debut novel, **"Serious Men"**, won the **Hindu Literary Prize** in **2010** and was adapted into a Netflix film in **2020**.
 
• His second novel, **"The Illicit Happiness of Other People"**, received critical acclaim for its exploration of psychological and societal issues.
 
 
 
• **The Plot of "Miss Laila, Armed and Dangerous":**
 
 
• The story is set in contemporary India and unfolds through the perspective of a young woman named Akhila Iyer, who investigates a terror suspect.
 
• The book critiques the functioning of government institutions and the media, blending satire with a gripping narrative.
 
• It highlights issues such as **individual privacy**, **nationalism**, and **communal politics** through a fictional yet realistic lens.
 
 
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **Sachin Kundalkar:** An Indian filmmaker and author, known for his Marathi novel **"Cobalt Blue"**.
 
• **Ruchir Joshi:** A writer and filmmaker, recognized for his novel **"The Last Jet-Engine Laugh"**.
 
• **Ajay K Pandey:** Known for his inspirational and romantic novels like **"You Are the Best Wife"**.
 
 
 
• **Thematic Importance:**
 
 
• Explores the impact of state surveillance and the erosion of personal freedoms.
 
• Delves into the psychological complexities of individuals caught in a politically charged environment.
